gate: Capture scheduler ownership, retry/idempotency behavior, and execution history parity.
live_state_note: Schedules are what the pinned source declares. Whether any crontab, Task Scheduler task or systemd timer is installed on a host was not inspected and is not claimed.

platform_workflow_main.detail: origin/main ships only contract/scaffold checks; there is no job store, retry, idempotency or execution-history code to exercise. PR #1 (codex/shared-infrastructure-20261015) proposes src/platform_workflow with PostgreSQL-backed idempotent enqueue, max_attempts, exponential backoff and an attempts table; it is unmerged and needs PostgreSQL and third-party packages, so it is not exercised here.

local-cron-rehome.basis: contract: platform-workflow owns execution state, business invariants stay with the caller (platform-repository-split.md#data-และ-interface-ownership); 3bf3637c says jobs return as Railway crons of their owning cells when needed

retire-orphan.basis: no JOB_MAP entry, so the legacy runner could never execute it

ci-stays-in-ci.scheduler_and_execution_state: GitHub Actions in the repository that owns the checked code
ci-stays-in-ci.basis: CI schedules are not runtime jobs; solo-empire removed its CI workflows in 3bf3637c, 9f44f602 and 5f034945

data-capture-rehome.basis: the installers were plan-only host schedulers; the capture logic belongs to the data products

ops-timer-rehome.basis: live ops timers today; moving the timer requires the platform-workflow runtime (not on main)

retire-workstation.basis: logon-triggered hosts-file sync for *.local domains, not a business job

legacy-local-cron-heal-once.summary: No in-run retry. cron_heal (every 4h) retries an active job whose last_status is 'failed' within the last 24h once (retry_count < 1), through the same per-job lock; a primary success or failure resets retry_count; still-failing jobs alert via Telegram; google_oauth_invalid_grant is marked manual recovery without retry. A lock overlap exits 0 and leaves status untouched. Optional-credential skips count as success.

legacy-local-cron-heal-self.summary: cron_heal is never retried by itself (get_failed_jobs skips job_type 'cron_heal'); a failed healer run waits for the next 4h tick.

legacy-local-cron-unrunnable.summary: job_type has a cron_jobs row in migrations but no JOB_MAP entry: cron_runner.py --install skips it and --run refuses it as an unknown job type, so it can neither run nor retry.

data-lake-capture-in-process-2-attempts.summary: The capture runner is invoked with --attempts 2 (and --timeout-seconds 180 for crontab installers); there is no scheduler-level retry. Overlap is blocked by a lock file.
data-lake-capture-in-process-2-attempts.backoff: inside the capture runner (not visible in the scheduler definition)

windows-task-no-retry.summary: Windows Task Scheduler task with no restart settings; MultipleInstances IgnoreNew (discovery) drops overlapping starts; the next trigger is the only retry.

github-actions-no-retry.summary: GitHub Actions on: schedule with no retry step; a failed run waits for the next cron or a manual workflow_dispatch. health-check opens an issue on failure.

systemd-oneshot-no-retry.summary: systemd user timer starting a Type=oneshot service with TimeoutStartSec and no Restart=; a running oneshot blocks the next start; Persistent=true catches up one missed run after downtime (org-hub, tracker-sync), Persistent=false does not (book-dev-dispatch).

legacy-automation-cell.summary: Last-run state only (last_run_at, last_status, retry_count, last_retry_at overwritten on the cron-jobs row of the solo-automation cell) plus a best-effort automation-log append (action_type 'cron', success, executed_at; failures to log are swallowed) and crontab stdout appended to data/logs/cron.log. No per-run record with attempt number, duration or error class.

data-lake-capture-logs.summary: Crontab stdout appended to data/logs/<feed>-feeds-cron.log plus the runner's --log-dir data/logs/<feed>-capture/. Host-local files only.

windows-scraping-logs.summary: data/logs/windows-scraping/ (2 MB x 3 rotating) plus Task Scheduler LastRunTime/LastTaskResult.

windows-discovery-log.summary: Metadata-only summary in data/logs/discovery-portfolio-scheduled.log (rotating) plus Task Scheduler LastRunTime/LastTaskResult.

windows-task-scheduler-only.summary: No application log; only Windows Task Scheduler's own last-run information.

github-actions-run-history.summary: GitHub Actions run list for the solo-empire repository (retention per GitHub settings); the workflow files were removed in 3bf3637c (backup), 9f44f602 (data-lake-cloud-contract, free-cloud-e2e) and 5f034945 (free-resource-upstream-audit, health-check, scorecard), so no new runs are produced.

systemd-journal.summary: journald for the user unit (journalctl --user -u <unit>) and the timer's last-trigger time; job-specific state: book-dev-dispatch ledger data/runtime/agent-loop/book-dev/linear/state.json, tracker-sync checkpoint.json under .runtime/tracker-sync-pilot, org-hub lock .runtime/org-hub-sync.lock.
